stable_id_note: New dedicated asset because the existing manifest contained no Maclure entry or asset; retain this ID and path when coordinator adds the shared manifest mapping.

identity.identity_check: GIS attribute match is corroborated by the current official Maclure Cooperative site stating its original house is 128 Wiggins Street, and by Purdue FSCL cooperative houses list.

placement.crs: Approximate project local tangent conversion per modular/AGENTS.md: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; units meters; not surveyed.
placement.origin_method: Shoelace centroid of official GIS FID 822 polygon after conversion. Detailed asset geometry is centered on this point; master Placement_maclure_cooperative marker should use these coordinates.
placement.orientation: Long axis is N-S; the official polygon and Esri imagery tile support the building orientation. Front facade toward Wiggins is inferred from address and official exterior photographs; no measured survey bearing.

sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 output; source layer native EPSG:3857
sources.use: Exact wall outline, footprint centroid, orientation. GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with visible two-story plus attic house and is not used as measured height.
Name, original address 128 Wiggins Street, claimed house age 1900; confirms continuity of identity.
Current official recognition/listing of Maclure as a Purdue cooperative and its official website link.

sources.provider: Maclure Cooperative official Our Home photo gallery
sources.image_caption: Outdoor section includes “Our Home”, “We have 5 parking spots” and “Our landscaping is under renovation”; site states in page text the landscaping changes were in summer 2018.
sources.use: Visible exterior colors, two-level clapboard massing, dark roof, front-facing gable/window, chimney, burgundy shutters, raised reddish deck with stairs/rails and lattice, garden stone/landscape. Photo capture date otherwise not confirmed.

sources.imagery_acquisition_date: Not supplied by tile metadata; treat as date-unverified.
sources.use: Spatial check of roof outline and N-S footprint orientation against FID 822. This is a low-resolution neighborhood tile, not facade/height evidence.

sources.provider: Maclure Cooperative official Our Home virtual tour
sources.use: First-floor foyer/formal living room, second-floor study rooms, cold-air dorm, basement BUM and laundry room names support only a schematic interior program.

modeling.walls: Sides follow official GIS FID 822 boundary vertices exactly in the project local approximation.
modeling.exterior: White horizontal siding; dark gray shingled gable roof; front cross-gable; red-brick chimney; paired shuttered windows; raised red-brown front deck, perimeter rails, lattice and stairs. Exterior details interpreted from official co-op photos.
modeling.estimated_dimensions: Wall top 6.0 m; ridge peak 9.0 m; model massing is consistent with two stories plus attic visible in images. No surveyed height source; all Z values and roof topology are estimates.
modeling.interior: Schematic room partitions, first-floor common living/dining, second-floor study-room beds/desks, basement lounge/laundry proxies; no architectural plans, arrangement and dimensions are unverified estimates.
modeling.materials: Portable procedural Blender materials; no external image texture dependency.

uncertainties: GIS feature is a static layer; data last edited on 2026-08-31, but it provides no survey accuracy metadata.
Official exterior photos are from the co-op site and landscaping caption dates renovation to 2018; no recent close exterior facade source found.
Roof profile, eave/ridge heights, fenestration count/spacing, materials at hidden sides, basement extent, and interior partition dimensions are estimated.
The official GIS NUM_LEVELS field says 1, inconsistent with the visible two-story plus attic facade; only XY footprint is treated as verified.
grade_request: Ready for independent visual and evidence grading; no independent score claimed by builder.
